verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Model APIs are billed per token and describe usage/budget tracking and rate limits, implying transparent metered pricing without a sales call [baseten-docs-10][baseten-docs-38][baseten-docs-40]. However, no evidence pack item shows an actual published price list or per-model token rates, and account tiers (Pro/Enterprise) still require using a contact form. Missing for 10: a concrete public pricing page with per-model $/token rates, confirmation that all hosted models (not just Model APIs) have public prices, and evidence no sales contact is needed for higher tiers.
